capabilities: Render dialogue messages from prefixed Markdown lines
Name left and right dialogue participants via parameters
Insert comments and delimiters between messages
Configure title mode, message and comment widths
Style messages per participant with CSS snippets and data attributes
disambiguation: Not a chat or messaging tool; it only renders dialogue-style text written in Markdown code blocks.
extras: Includes a 'Say Thanks' section linking to a coffee donation option; results are shown only as images, which were stripped, so rendered-output examples are not verifiable from the text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render written conversations or chat exchanges as visual dialogue bubbles inside Markdown notes.
summary: Markdown code block renderer that turns prefixed text lines into left/right chat-style dialogue bubbles with participants, comments, delimiters, and customizable parameters.
